items.exampleEn: The cleaner at our school is very kind.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校的清潔人員很親切。

items.exampleEn: Please tidy your room before dinner.
items.exampleZh: 晚餐前請把房間整理好。

items.exampleEn: We need a bigger bookcase for all these books.
items.exampleZh: 我們需要一個更大的書櫃來放這些書。

items.exampleEn: Take the escalator to the second floor.
They live in a small apartment in the city.
items.exampleZh: 他們住在城裡一間小公寓。

items.exampleEn: Can I use your mirror for a minute?
items.exampleZh: 我可以借用一下你的鏡子嗎？

items.exampleEn: Please close the gate behind you.
items.exampleZh: 進出後請隨手關上大門。

items.exampleEn: Birds often sit on our roof.
items.exampleZh: 常常有鳥停在我們家屋頂上。

items.sentenceEn: My apartment has a big mirror in the hall.
items.sentenceZh: 我的公寓走廊上有一面大鏡子。

items.audioEn: The escalator is broken, so please use the stairs.
options: The elevator is full of people

items.sentenceEn: Her desk is always clean and tidy.
items.sentenceZh: 她的書桌總是乾淨又整齊。

items.sentenceEn: The rain came in through a hole in the roof.
items.sentenceZh: 雨從屋頂的一個破洞漏了進來。

items.stemEn: I can't find my book. Did you look in the ____?
items.stemZh: 我找不到我的書。你找過書櫃了嗎？

items.stemEn: Can you help me ____ my desk? I can't find anything.
items.stemZh: 你可以幫我整理書桌嗎？我什麼都找不到。

items.passageEn: Amy's new apartment is small but tidy. There is a tall bookcase in the living room and a big mirror next to the door. Outside, there is a small gate next to a quiet street. On the roof, there is a garden where Amy grows vegetables. A cleaner comes every Friday, but Amy tidies the kitchen herself every night.
items.passageZh: Amy 的新公寓很小，但很整齊。客廳裡有一個高高的書櫃，門邊有一面大鏡子。屋外有一道小門，就在一條安靜的街旁邊。屋頂上有個花園，Amy 在那裡種菜。每週五會有清潔人員來，不過 Amy 每天晚上都自己整理廚房。

referenceEn: You can find the escalator over there.

items.instructionZh: 用 mirror 造一個句子，說說你家的鏡子在哪裡，或你什麼時候會照鏡子。
referenceEn: There is a long mirror in my bedroom.
I always look in the mirror before work.
rubricZh: mirror 是可數名詞（例如 a mirror、the mirror）
「照鏡子」可寫 look in the mirror；說位置可用 There is a mirror in…

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：釋義「清潔工；清潔劑」：例句是人（A cleaner comes to our office），「清潔劑」是例句沒示範的另一義，且與干擾項（警衛／司機／郵差，都是人）詞類不對稱；建議只寫「清潔工；清潔人員」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "清潔工；清潔人員"（原 "清潔工；清潔劑"）；照建議只留人義

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：「屋頂上有個小花園」：原文 a garden 沒有「小」，多加資訊
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Amy 的新公寓很小，但很整齊。客廳裡有一個高高的書櫃，門邊有一面大鏡子。屋外有一道小門，就在一條安靜的街旁邊。屋頂上有個花園，Amy 在那裡種菜。每週五會有清潔人員來，不過 Amy 每天晚上都自己整理廚房。"（原 "Amy 的新公寓很小，但很整齊。客廳裡有一個高高的書櫃，門邊有一面大鏡子。屋外有一道小門，就在一條安靜的街旁邊。屋頂上有個小花園，Amy 在那裡種菜。每週五會有清潔人員來，不過 Amy 每天晚上都自己整理廚房。"）；刪去原文沒有的「小」
